newsitem.title: UK: Renault set to sign with UK part suppliers - paper.
newsitem.headline: Renault set to sign with UK part suppliers - paper.

text.p: French carmaker Renault is set to sign deals with more than 40 British car part suppliers in an effort to drive down costs, the Financial Times reported on Monday.
The newspaper said Renault was just one of many French manufacturers, including carmaker Peugeot-Citroen, to be looking for British suppliers.
Renault's purchasing division has an annual components budget of about 60 billion French francs ($10.86 billion).
Earlier this month, the group's chairman Louis Schweitzer told Le Figaro newspaper that Renault's car division losses were likely to have worsened in 1996.
